exposure: Postnatal, orally delivered maternal fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT)
cohort: Seven term Cesarean section-born infants whose mothers were carefully screened and who received a diluted fecal sample from their own mothers postnatally.
finding: Postnatal maternal fecal microbiota transplantation successfully restored the intestinal microbiota development in Cesarean section-born infants to resemble that of vaginally born infants, with no adverse effects observed during a 3-month follow-up.
mod_finding: The temporal development of the fecal microbiota composition in FMT-treated Cesarean section-born infants showed significant similarity to that of vaginally born infants, diverging from that of untreated Cesarean section-born infants.
